decisions.reason: Removing the landing-page audit workstream does not change the active objective of producing winning creative with CPL below ₹80; it only removes one proposed diagnostic task.
The client separately establishes the eight-video, 45-second, 16-file creative package in the same message; removing landing-page work does not alter those deliverables.
The client separately requires the creative scope to include footage, voiceover, and script; removing landing-page work does not change those production-input responsibilities.
